name: Tide One
contextCaption: Tide One on an early towpath run
alt: Tide One running shoe in off-white mesh with a clay heel and a cream foam sole, side view
blurb: A light daily trainer with a soft rocker for easy and steady miles.
desc: Tide One is the pair our own team reaches for most mornings. The engineered mesh opens up where you heat up, the clay heel counter holds without pressing, and a gently rocked foam midsole rolls you through each stride without feeling tall.

fit.text: True to size with a roomy toe box. If you are between sizes and like a locked-in feel, take the smaller size.

care: Remove the insole and laces. Hand wash the upper with cold water and a soft brush, then air dry away from direct heat.
keywords: mesh road daily trainer rocker coral clay white chalk running

name: Drift Knit
alt: Drift Knit running shoe in pale grey knit with a slate blue heel and white foam sole, side view
blurb: A cushioned knit runner for longer days on your feet.
desc: Drift Knit wraps the foot in a one-piece knit with a stretch collar, so it slips on like a sock and stays put. The deeper foam stack is tuned for long runs, and for nurses, teachers and anyone standing through a ten-hour shift.

fit.text: True to size. The knit relaxes after the first week, so if you are between sizes take the smaller one.

care: Hand wash cold with a soft brush and air dry. Drift Knit cannot be resoled because the knit and foam are bonded as one piece.
keywords: knit cushioned long run slip on grey blue slate mist running

name: Rally Mid
contextCaption: Rally Mid at the Tuesday pickup game
alt: Rally Mid high-top in bone leather with forest green suede overlays, side view
blurb: A leather high-top with a grippy herringbone outsole for pickup games.
desc: Rally Mid keeps the shape of a classic court high-top and adds what the modern game needs: a padded collar that locks the ankle, a firm heel cup, and a herringbone outsole that bites on dusty community-centre floors.

fit.text: Runs half a size large. Most players take half a size down. If you wear thick court socks, stay in your usual size.

care: Wipe the leather with a damp cloth, brush the suede when dry, and condition the leather every few months.
keywords: leather high top court basketball green forest bone white

name: Loop Strap
alt: Loop Strap mid-top in white leather with brick red suede panels and an ankle strap, side view
blurb: A mid-top court shoe with an ankle strap for studio and street.
desc: Loop Strap borrows the strap and cupsole of an old gym shoe and trims the weight. The brick suede panels soften with wear, and the strap adds a second lock for dance class, the studio or a run for the bus.

fit.text: True to size. Snug through the midfoot for the first few wears until the leather softens.

care: Wipe the leather with a damp cloth and brush the suede when dry. Keep the strap closed when washing so it does not collect lint.
keywords: leather mid top strap court dance studio red brick white chalk

name: Ridge Form
alt: Ridge Form shoe in stone suede and ripstop with umber overlays, toggle laces and a lugged sole, side view
blurb: A suede trail shoe with 4 mm lugs for gravel, towpaths and wet grass.
desc: Ridge Form is built for the paths at the edge of town. A suede and ripstop upper sheds light rain, the rubber toe bumper takes the knocks, and 4 mm lugs grip on gravel without feeling clumsy on the pavement that gets you there.

fit.text: Runs slightly small. Take half a size up if you wear thick socks or have a high instep.

care: Let mud dry, then brush it off. Re-proof the suede with a water-repellent spray every few months.
keywords: trail suede lugs gravel hiking outdoor brown umber stone beige toggle

name: Yard Runner
contextCaption: Yard Runner in the Marlowe training studio
alt: Yard Runner training shoe in moss green knit with a flat charcoal sole, side view
blurb: A low, stable trainer for lifting, classes and short runs.
desc: Yard Runner sits low to the floor on a wide, flat base, so it stays planted under a barbell and still feels easy on the jog home. The moss knit is reinforced at the toe, where rope climbs and burpees wear through first.
materials: Firm EVA on a wide base

fit.text: True to size with a wide forefoot. Narrow feet may prefer half a size down.

care: Brush off chalk when dry. Hand wash cold with a soft brush and air dry away from heat.
keywords: gym training lifting knit stable flat green moss olive charcoal

name: Metro Quiet
contextCaption: Metro Quiet in Fog, from the autumn campaign
alt: Metro Quiet retro runner in fog grey suede over pale mesh with a cream sole, side view
blurb: A retro runner in layered suede for every day that is not a run.
desc: Metro Quiet takes the shape of a late-seventies trainer and gives it softer foam and a calmer palette. Layered fog suede over breathable mesh looks sharp with tailoring and easy with denim, and the cream sole ages well.

fit.text: True to size with a medium toe box. Wide is available if you usually size up for width.

care: Brush the suede with a suede brush, lift marks with a suede eraser and use a water-repellent spray before the first wear.
keywords: retro runner suede grey fog cream everyday lifestyle city

name: Everyday Arc
alt: Everyday Arc low-top in cream canvas with a navy toe cap and a honey gum sole, side view
blurb: A cotton canvas low-top on a vulcanized gum sole.
desc: Everyday Arc is the simplest pair we make: heavy organic cotton canvas, a navy toe cap and a vulcanized gum sole that flexes from the first day. It is the pair you stop thinking about, which is the point.

fit.text: Runs half a size large. Take half a size down from your usual size.

care: Spot clean the canvas with mild soap and a soft brush. Stuff with paper and air dry.
keywords: canvas low top vulcanized gum navy cream classic everyday summer
